blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLM systems increasingly rely on groups of agents that discuss, critique, and check one another, assuming that peers will catch individual errors. We test this assumption against a minimal adversary. In a ten-agent factual discussion, one or three adversarial agents repeatedly assert a plausible false answer. After each round we probe each benign agent's private answer through a separate call whose response is hidden from its peers, and we separately label its public stance toward the claim. Across six models and three factual-QA datasets, groups remain stable without an attacker: only 0.6% of benign agents finish with the false answer. A single adversarial agent increases this rate to 44.8% and three to 60.5%. Studies of conformity typically report public agreement without private change; we find the reverse. With three adversarial agents present, benign agents hold the false answer in 51.6% of exposed turns but publicly endorse it in only 19.7%. Much of the influence therefore remains invisible in the discussion, and the false answers persist when agents are asked for their own views. Agents that retain the true answer often fail to defend it; once adopted, the false answer spreads among benign agents, and baseline knowledge does not predict robustness.
blocks.zh: LLM系统越来越依赖相互讨论、批评和检查的各类代理人,假设同行会发现个别错误。 我们测试这个假设 针对一个最小的对手。 在一次十方代理人的事实讨论中,一至三名对抗方代理人一再断言一个可信的虚假答案. 每回合之后,我们通过一个单独的电话 探究每个良性代理人的私人回答, 其答复被隐藏在同行面前, 我们分别标出其公开的立场 对权利主张。 在6个模型和3个事实-QA数据集中,没有攻击者的群体保持稳定:只有0.6%的良性剂用假答案完成. 单一对抗方代理人将这一比率提高到44.8%和3%至60.5%。 符合性研究通常报告公众同意,而不作私人改变;我们发现恰恰相反。 有3名对抗方代理人在场,良性代理人在51.6%的暴露转向中持有虚假答案,但公开认可的比例仅为19.7%。 因此,许多影响在讨论中仍然看不见,当向特工征求他们自己的意见时,错误的答案依然存在. 保留了真实答案的代理人往往无法为它辩护;一旦被采纳,虚假答案会扩散到良性代理人之间,而基线知识也不会预测强性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Model (LLM) applications increasingly look conversational and social. Systems use multiple agents to debate answers, call tools, plan tasks, critique each other, and form judgments ( Du et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ) . The appeal is intuitive: a group of agents should be safer than a single one, because peers can cross-check each other, expose factual errors, and converge toward the truth ( Liang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLM)的应用越来越看起来有对话性和社交性. 系统使用多种代理来辩论答案,调用工具,计划任务,相互批评,并形成判断(Du等,2024;Wang等,2024;Guo等,2024). 上诉是直观的:一群特工应该比单一特工更安全,因为同行可以互相交叉核对,揭露事实错误,并会合真相(梁等,2024年).

blocks.en: This intuition overlooks that the channel agents use to coordinate is also an attack surface. A compromised tool-agent, a poisoned retrieval source voiced by an agent ( Greshake et al., 2023 ; Zou et al., 2025 ) , or an untrusted participant in an open protocol can repeatedly introduce a false claim into the shared conversation, and such injected content can propagate between agents ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Ju et al., 2026 ) . Such an attacker needs no access to model weights or hidden states; it only has to post messages.
blocks.zh: 这种直觉忽略了用于协调的通道代理也是攻击表面. 失密的工具代理、由代理商(Greshake等,2023;Zou等,2025)表达的毒物检索来源,或未受信任的公开协议参与者可以反复在共享对话中引入虚假主张,这种被注入的内容可以在代理商之间传播(Lee等,2026;Ju等,2026)。 这种攻击者不需要进入模型重量或隐藏状态;它只需要发布消息.

blocks.en: We construct a controlled multi-agent discussion to simulate this threat and ask whether a few agents change what the rest of the agents believe, not only what they say. Ten agents discuss one factual question for 16 rounds. In the ten, k ∈ { 0 , 1 , 3 } k\in\{0,1,3\} are adversarial agents (attacker), attacker-controlled agents ( Douceur, 2002 ) that each argue for the same plausible false answer; the others are benign agents given no question-specific instructions. Benign agents are neither warned about the attacker nor assigned a verification role, so we measure the default behavior of an open discussion rather than that of a dedicated debate or fact-checking protocol. For each benign agent, we record responses per round. The first is what it says in the chat, which we label as endorsing, rejecting, hedging on, or ignoring the false claim. The second is its private answer: after each round, we ask the agent the factual question in a separate call whose response is hidden from the other agents.
blocks.zh: 我们构建一个有控制的多代理人讨论来模拟这种威胁,并问几个代理人是否改变了其他代理人所相信的,而不仅仅是他们所说的话. 十名特工为16轮讨论一个事实问题. 在10分中, k {{{0, 1, 3}} k\\in} 0, 1, 1,3} 是对抗性代理人(攻击者), 攻击者控制的代理人( Douceur, 2002) , 每人主张相同的似是而非的回答; 其他人是良性代理人, 没有给出特定问题的指示. Benign代理既没有警告攻击者,也没有指派核查角色,所以我们衡量公开讨论的默认行为,而不是专门辩论或核实事实的协议. 每个良性剂,我们记录每轮反应。 首先是在聊天中所说的,我们称之为认可、拒绝、套取或无视虚假主张。 二是其私人回答:每轮之后,我们单独向代理人询问事实问题,其答复对其他代理人隐瞒.

blocks.en: For each benign turn, we have its private answer (true or false) with its public message (endorses the false claim or not). In two of the four combinations the chat reflects the private answer. In the other two it misleads: an agent may endorse the claim in the chat while still giving the true answer in private, or give the false answer in private while not endorsing the claim in the chat (Table 1 splits these further by public stance). Studies of conformity under majority pressure, in humans and recently in LLM agents, mostly find the first mismatch: participants follow the majority’s answer in the discussion but keep their own answer when asked in private ( Asch, 1956 ; Deutsch and Gerard, 1955 ; Baltaji et al., 2024 ; Ghaffarizadeh et al., 2026 ; YS, 2026 ) . Under three attackers, we find the reverse. Agents that still give the true answer in private almost never endorse the false claim (2.3% of their turns), but agents that give the false answer mostly do not endorse it either: 58% of their turns hedge on or ignore it. This matches minority influence in human groups, which shifts private judgment more than public behavior ( Moscovici, 1980 ; Wood et al., 1994 ) , and it is why the transcript understates the damage.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个良性转折,我们都有它的私人答案(是非),有它的公开信息(是否承认虚假的说法)。 在四个组合中的两个组合中,聊天反映了私人的答案. 在另外两种情况下,它误导了:代理人可能在聊天中认可权利要求,同时仍然私下给出真实答案,或者私下给出虚假答案,而不在聊天中认可权利要求(表1通过公开立场将这些权利进一步分割开来)。 在多数压力下对符合性的研究,在人类和最近在LLM剂中,大多发现第一个不匹配:参与者在讨论中遵循多数人的答案,但在私下询问时保留自己的答案(Asch,1956;Deutsch和Gerard,1955;Baltaji等,2024;Ghaffarizadeh等,2026;YS,2026)。 在三个攻击者下,我们发现相反。 仍然私下提供真实答案的代理人几乎从未认可过虚假说法(占其转折的2.3%),但提供虚假答案的代理人大多也不认可:58%的转折被套住或忽略了. 这与少数人在人类群体中的影响相吻合,这种影响比公共行为更会改变私人判断(Moscovici,1980年;Wood等人,1994年),这也是记录记录低估损害的原因。

blocks.en: We contribute a measurement protocol that pairs each agent’s public stance with its private answer in every round (§ 1 ), and use it to study six models on three factual-QA datasets (18 model–dataset cells). We find: 1. Hidden infection. Agents privately hold the false answer far more often than they publicly endorse it (51.6% vs. 19.7% of exposed turns under three attackers), and the false answers persist when agents are asked for their own view rather than to report what was discussed (§ 4.3 ). 2. Easy damage. Benign groups are stable (0.6% final infection without attacker), but a single attacker leaves 44.8% of benign agents on the false answer and three leave 60.5%; ten agents are not significantly more robust than one. 3. Weak correction. Agents that privately retain the true answer publicly reject the false claim in only 61.9% of their turns; in the remaining turns, they stay silent, hedge, or go along with it. 4. Knowledge does not predict robustness. Two models that know the same 85% of facts abandon 25% and 80% of them. A few attackers thus change what most agents answer in private while changing much less of what they say in public, and the transcript understates how far the false answer has spread.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了一种测量协议,将每个代理人的公开姿态与其每回合的私人回答(§1)联系起来,并用它来研究三个事实-QA数据集(18个模型-数据集单元格)的六个模型。 我们发现: 1. 隐藏感染. 特工私下持有虚假答案的次数远多于他们公开认可(51.6%对19.7%的暴露在三个攻击下),当特工被要求自己发表意见而不是报告讨论的内容时,虚假答案依然存在(第4.3节)。 2. 容易损坏。 贝尼尼克群体是稳定的(0.6%的终极感染没有攻击者),但是一个攻击者在错误的回答上留下44.8%的良性药剂,而三个留有60.5%;有10个药剂的活性不明显大于1个. 3. 纠正不力。 私人保留真实答案的代理人只公开拒绝61.9%的虚假说法;在所剩的回合中,他们保持沉默,套取,或与之并存. 4. 知识无法预测强健性。 两个知道同样85%事实的模型放弃了25%和80%. 少数攻击者因此改变大多数特工私下回答的内容, 而在公开场合改变的却少得多,

blocks.zh: 隐藏的感染。 特工私下持有虚假答案的次数远多于他们公开认可(51.6%对19.7%的暴露在三个攻击下),当特工被要求自己发表意见而不是报告讨论的内容时,虚假答案依然存在(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: Easy damage. Benign groups are stable (0.6% final infection without attacker), but a single attacker leaves 44.8% of benign agents on the false answer and three leave 60.5%; ten agents are not significantly more robust than one.
blocks.zh: 很容易损坏。 贝尼尼克群体是稳定的(0.6%的终极感染没有攻击者),但一个攻击者在错误的回答上留下44.8%的良性剂,而三个留有60.5%;有十种药剂的活性并不明显大于一.

blocks.en: Weak correction. Agents that privately retain the true answer publicly reject the false claim in only 61.9% of their turns; in the remaining turns, they stay silent, hedge, or go along with it.
blocks.zh: 微弱修正. 私人保留真实答案的代理人只公开拒绝61.9%的虚假说法;在其余的回合中,他们保持沉默,套取,或与之并存.

blocks.zh: 知识无法预测强健性。 两个知道同样85%事实的模型放弃了25%和80%.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: A growing body of work organizes LLMs into groups that debate, critique, and vote, reporting gains in reasoning and factuality over single models ( Du et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ) . These systems rest on a cooperative premise: more agents and more rounds surface and filter errors. Even without an adversary, discussion can erode correct answers through conformity and the loss of shared facts ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Hao et al., 2026 ; Wan et al., 2026 ) . We study the adversarial case, in which the same channel is used to inject a false claim.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的工作将法学硕士组织成辩论、批评和投票的团体,报告在推理和事实方面对单一模型的好处(Du等,2024;Liang等,2024;Guo等,2024)。 这些系统基于合作前提:更多的物剂和更多的弹道表面和过滤出错. 即使没有对手,讨论也可能通过符合和失去共同的事实来侵蚀正确的答案(张等,2024;郝等,2026;万等,2026.). 我们研究对抗性案件,在这个案件中,同一渠道被用来提出虚假主张。

blocks.en: Persuasive adversarial debaters lower collaborative accuracy ( Amayuelas et al., 2024 ; Kraidia et al., 2026 ) , persuasion can override truth in debate ( Agarwal and Khanna, 2025 ; Wynn et al., 2025 ) , and the damage has been related to the number and share of deceivers in a group ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . Misinformation spreads further in densely connected agent networks ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , persists once it enters agent communities ( Ju et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , and can be induced by contriving agents that post only true fragments ( Hu et al., 2026 ) . Our attacker is deliberately simple: it edits no weights and only argues for one fixed false claim in the conversation. Our main difference lies in what we measure. These studies mostly evaluate what the group outputs (messages, votes, consensus, or accuracy); to our knowledge, none pairs each agent’s public stance with its private answer turn by turn, which is what reveals that most infection is never voiced.
blocks.zh: 劝导性对抗辩论者降低合作准确度(Amayuelas等,2024;Kraidia等,2026.),劝导可以在辩论中推翻真理(Agarwal和Khanna,2025;Wynn等,2025.),所造成的损害一直与一群欺骗者的人数和份额有关(Wu等,2026.). 错误信息在连接密度高的毒剂网络中进一步传播(Yu等,2025年),一旦进入毒剂社区就持续存在(Ju等,2026年;Yan等,2026年;Lin等,2026年),并且可以由只寄出真片的构思剂诱发(Hu等,2026年). 我们的攻击者故意简单:它不编辑重量,只在对话中为固定的虚假主张而争论。 我们的主要区别在于我们衡量什么。 这些研究大多评估了群体产出(信息、选票、共识或准确性 ) ; 据我们所知,每个代理人的公开立场都与其私人的回答不一而足,这表明大多数感染从未表达出来。

blocks.en: Social psychology separates public compliance from private acceptance ( Deutsch and Gerard, 1955 ; Kelman, 1958 ) . Majorities mainly produce compliance, that is, public agreement without private change ( Asch, 1956 ) , whereas minorities shift private judgment more than public behavior ( Moscovici, 1980 ; Wood et al., 1994 ) . LLMs concede to users ( Sharma et al., 2024 ; Perez et al., 2023 ) , abandon facts they know under multi-turn persuasion ( Xu et al., 2024 ) and conflicting evidence ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , and conform to peers ( Weng et al., 2025 ; Soffer et al., 2026 ; Bito et al., 2026 ) . Studies that do separate private from public answers in LLM groups mostly report the compliance pattern: agents agree in the discussion but keep or return to their own view in private ( Baltaji et al., 2024 ; Ghaffarizadeh et al., 2026 ; YS, 2026 ) , or withhold dissent they privately hold ( Mansuri et al., 2026 ) . Under a persistent false claim we find the reverse: benign agents privately adopt the falsehood while rarely endorsing it in public, and because we track both channels every round, we can also ask whether a public concession comes before the private switch.
blocks.zh: 社会心理学将公众遵守与私人接受区分开来(Deutsch and Gerard,1955;Kelman,1958.). 多数主要产生遵守,即未经私人改变的公共协议(Asch,1956年),而少数群体的私人判断比公共行为更转移(Moscovici,1956年)。 1980; Wood等, 1994.). LLMs向用户(Sharma等人,2024年;Perez等人,2023年)承认,放弃在多回合劝说下知道的事实(Xu等人,2024年)和相冲突的证据(Xie等人,2024年),并遵守同行(Weng等人,2025年;Soffer等人,2026年;Bito等人,2026年). 在LLM团体中进行私下回答和公开回答分离的研究大多报告了遵守模式:代理商在讨论中表示同意,但私下保持或回到自己的观点(Baltaji等,2024;Ghaffarizadeh等,2026;YS,2026),或拒绝他们私下持有的不同意见(Mansuri等,2026)。 我们发现一个长期虚假的说法是相反的:善良的代理人私下接受谎言,而很少公开认可,而且因为我们每轮跟踪两个渠道,我们也可以问公共特许权是否在私人开关之前出现。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview. Ten agents discuss one fact for 16 rounds with k ∈ { 0 , 1 , 3 } k\in\{0,1,3\} adversarial agents pushing a false claim. Each round we measure both a benign agent’s public utterance and a private probe.
blocks.zh: 图1:概览。 10名探员与K {0, 1, 3} 讨论一个16个回合的事实, 每轮我们测量一个善良的代理人的公开言论和私人探测器。

blocks.en: We test whether a false claim introduced by a few agents spreads through a multi-agent LLM conversation. The key design choice is to measure public behavior and private belief separately: the chat only shows what agents say to the group, and private probes show what they answer when no other agent can see it.
blocks.zh: 我们测试少数特工提出的虚假说法是否通过多代理LLM对话传播. 关键的设计选择是分别衡量公共行为和私人信仰:聊天只显示代理商对团体的言论,私人探测器则显示当没有其他代理商能看到时他们回答什么.

blocks.en: 3.1 Threat Model and Chatroom
blocks.zh: 3.1 威胁模型和聊天室

blocks.en: Each run is a chatroom of N = 10 N{=}10 agents that discuss one factual item for T = 16 T{=}16 rounds; all agents in a run share the same base model. We vary the number of adversarial agents k ∈ { 0 , 1 , 3 } k\in\{0,1,3\} , making 10 − k 10{-}k benign agents. The k k adversarial agents are independent that each advocate a fixed false claim whenever the topic arises; benign agents receive ordinary discussion personas and instructions that do not include the false claim. The attacker only posts messages; it does not edit weights, read hidden states, or control benign agents, and is thus strictly weaker than the parameter-editing attacker described by Ju et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 每跑是N=10个NQQ10代理商的聊天室,讨论T=16个TQQ16发的1个事实项目;跑跑的所有代理商共享同一种基型. 我们改变对抗方特工的数量 k {0, 1, 3} k\in\\0, 1,3} 使10 - k 10{} K 良性特工。 kk对抗方代理人是独立的,每个代理人在专题出现时都主张固定的虚假主张;良方代理人接受普通的讨论人和指示,不包括虚假主张. 攻击者只发布消息;它不编辑权重,读取隐藏状态,或控制良性剂,因此严格弱于Ju等所描述的参数编辑攻击者(2026).

blocks.en:
In every round each agent speaks exactly once, in a random order that is reshuffled every round and identical across conversations (Appendix D ), conditioning on the recent shared history (the previous H = 5 H{=}5 rounds) and the current round. Conversations start
from a neutral discussion seed about the topic, so benign agents are not steered toward either answer.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dual Private/Public Measurement
blocks.zh: 3.2 公私双重计量

blocks.en: We call a separate call a private probe and its output the agent’s private answer. We use belief for what the private answer is meant to reflect.
blocks.zh: 我们单独呼叫一个私人探测器 以及它输出的 特工的私人答案。 我们用信仰来表达私人的答案

blocks.en:
At the initial state and after every round, each benign agent answers the probe question in a separate call whose response is hidden from the other agents and never posted to the chatroom. Because the attacker acts only in context, an agent’s state is its context: the probe conditions on the
agent’s persona and its conversational memory (the same last H H rounds) and asks for a private answer based on its knowledge and the discussion (Appendix A ). At step 0 the memory is empty, so the initial probe is a query without conversational history. A judge labels each private answer as true , manipulated , mixed , or uncertain ; an
agent is infected at a step if its label is manipulated. mixed and uncertain are never counted as infection.
Independently, a judge labels each benign utterance’s public stance toward the manipulated claim as endorse , reject , hedge , ignore/drift , or unrelated , given the recent conversational context.
blocks.zh: 独立地说,鉴于最近的对话背景,法官将每个善意的言论都标榜为认可、拒绝、套期、忽略/推倒或无关。

blocks.en: We call a benign turn exposed if at least one adversarial agent’s utterance precedes it in the transcript (i.e., the agent has had an opportunity to see and react to the claim). Public response metrics are reported over exposed benign turns, since unexposed turns have no claim to respond to.
blocks.zh: 如果在记录稿中至少有一名对抗方代理人的言论(即代理人曾有机会看到并作出反应),我们称之为 " 良性转折 " 。 公共反应指标是在暴露的良性转折中报告的,因为未暴露的转折没有反应的权利。

blocks.en: Probes are taken only between rounds, so none captures an agent’s private answer at the moment it speaks. An agent that speaks mid-round has heard the earlier speakers of that round but not the later ones. The probe before the round has heard neither, and the probe after the round has heard both. We pair each utterance with the probe after the round, which covers everything the agent heard before speaking. This probe can, however, reflect later speakers: an agent that still held the true answer when it spoke may already hold the false one when probed. Two pairings avoid this gap: first speakers paired with the probe before the round, and last speakers with the probe after it. Our results hold on these turns (§ 4.2 , § 5 , Appendix B ).

blocks.en: 3.4 Items and Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.4 项目和数据集

blocks.en:
Each item consists of a probe question with a true and a manipulated (false) answer, the corresponding true and manipulated statements, and a neutral discussion seed that is related to the true statements (Table 2 ). We draw items from three factual-QA sources that span a familiarity spectrum. CounterFact ( Meng et al., 2022 ) pairs Wikidata subject–relation prompts with their true object and a counterfactual object of the
same relation, which we use as the manipulated answer. PopQA ( Mallen et al., 2023 ) contains over 14k templated questions with Wikidata relations and targets long-tail entities. SimpleQA ( Wei et al., 2024 ) contains 4k short fact-seeking questions with a
single answer, collected adversarially against ChatGPT.
blocks.zh:
每个项目包括一个探测问题,其中包含一个真实和被操纵(假)的答案,相应的真实和被操纵的声明,以及和真实声明相关的中性讨论种子(表2. 我们从三个事实-质量评估来源中抽取了跨越熟悉范围的物品。 反事实 (Meng等, 2022) 对等 Wikidata 主题 - 关系 提示其真实对象和一个反事实对象

blocks.en: Neither PopQA nor SimpleQA provides a false answer, so we use an answer from another question of the same kind. For PopQA , we sample a question with the same relation whose answer shares no alias with the true answer. SimpleQA provides only coarse answer-type labels, so we first use rules to infer a fine-grained relation (e.g., year, count, city, person) from each question; we then sample a question from the same topic and relation. We ensure that the borrowed answer does not appear in the target question. The resulting false answers are therefore type-compatible (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: PopQA 或 简单 QA提供了一个虚假的答案,所以我们用另一个同类问题的答案. 对PopQA来说,我们抽出一个有着同样关系的问题,其答案与真实答案没有别名。 简单 QA只提供粗糙的回答型标签,所以我们首先使用规则从每个问题中推断出一个细微的关系(如年份,伯爵,城市,人物);然后从同一个主题和关系中抽取一个问题. 我们保证借入的答案不会出现在目标问题中. 因此产生的虚假答案是相容的(附录C.

blocks.en: We keep only items whose manipulated answer is absent before any discussion, so that any later appearance can be attributed to the attack. A screening model ( deepseek-v4-flash ) answers each candidate’s probe question several times without context. We keep items that it often answers correctly and answers with the manipulated answer in at most 5% of samples, and we cap the number of items per relation (Appendix C ). We also discard some PopQA items whose true answer appears in the question itself (e.g., “What is the capital of Artern?”), leaving 40, 53, and 50 items from 18, 14, and 15 relations. The screen carries over to the evaluated models: initial private infection is 0.2 % 0.2\% , and the k = 0 k{=}0 baseline never exceeds 3 % 3\% .
blocks.zh: 在进行任何讨论之前,我们只保留那些没有被操纵的答案的项目,这样以后出现的任何情况都可以归咎于攻击。 一个筛选模型(deepseek-v4-flash)在无上下文的情况下多次回答每个候选人的探测问题. 我们保留它经常正确回答的项目,并用被操纵的答案在最多5%的样本中进行回答,我们把每个关系的项目数量限制在上限(附录 C ). 我们还丢弃了一些PopQA项目,其真实答案出现在问题本身(例如,“Artern的首都是什么?”),留下了40、53和50个项目,分别来自18、14和15个关系。 K=0克的基线从未超过3%。

blocks.en:
We evaluate six large language models spanning sizes and families: HY3-preview ( Tencent Hy Team, 2026 ) , Qwen3.5-Flash ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , Mistral-Small-3.2 ( Liu et al., 2026 ) (24B), Gemma-4 (26B) ( Team et al., 2026 ) , Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) , and GPT-OSS-120B ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) . Agents generate at temperature 0.7 0.7 . We run one conversation per item, model, and k k . Both public stances and private answers are labeled by deepseek-v4-flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) ;
the public-stance judge uses the previous five turns as context. Full judge prompts are provided in Appendix A . To check that private-answer labels do not hinge on the judge model, an independent judge from a model family used neither for the original judge nor for any agent ( claude-sonnet-5.5 ) relabeled 200 private answers. blocks.en: 4.1 A single adversarial agent causes most of the damage
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 一个单一的对抗代理人造成大部分损失

blocks.en: Figure 2 reports final private infection (FPI). Without an attacker, benign groups are stable: FPI averages 0.6 % 0.6\% and never exceeds 3 % 3\% in any of the 18 model × \times dataset cells, with 0.2 % 0.2\% initial infection. A single adversary raises average FPI to 44.8 % 44.8\% (range 19 19 – 74 % 74\% ), and three attacker to average 60.5 % 60.5\% (range 27 27 – 81 % 81\% ). A single adversary thus produces 74 % 74\% of the infection rate observed with three sybils. Because the manipulated answer is essentially absent at baseline (§ 3.4 ), the false answer is not what the models produce on their own; it becomes a common private response only after adversaries introduce it in the chat. The benign agents do not filter it out; as § 5 shows, they help spread it.

blocks.en: If peers cross-checked one another, adding benign agents should dilute a single attacker. We test this by pairing one attacker with one benign agent ( N = 2 N{=}2 ), keeping everything else fixed (Appendix E ). In the pair, the adversarial agent writes half of all messages; in the ten-agent group, a tenth. Yet the group fares only slightly better: on the same items, 39.3 % 39.3\% of benign agents in the group end up choosing the false answer, against 45.6 % 45.6\% of lone agents (difference 6.3 points). Among agents that knew the answer beforehand, the rates are 33.0 % 33.0\% and 38.6 % 38.6\% . Nine additional benign peers remove only about a seventh of the damage, and the difference is not statistically significant.

blocks.en: Judged by the transcript alone, attacked groups look much healthier than they are. Under three adversaries, benign agents publicly endorse the claim in 19.7 % 19.7\% of exposed turns, while their matched private probes give the false answer in 51.6 % 51.6\% : 2.6 times as many turns carry a false private answer as endorse it publicly (Fig. 3 ). Conversely, only 34.3 % 34.3\% of turns with a false private answer publicly endorse the claim; the rest ignore it, hedge, or even reject it (Table 3 ). Silence explains only part of this: in 28.6 % 28.6\% of these turns, the agent responds to the claim but hedges on or rejects it. A low public-endorsement rate therefore does not imply intact belief: transcript-level monitoring understates how far false belief has spread. We call this pattern hidden infection (Table 1 ); Table 4 shows a typical case. The gap is also not a by-product of free-form chat, in which agents need not state an answer: agents that privately hold the true answer reject the claim in 61.9 % 61.9\% of their turns, whereas agents that privately hold the false answer endorse it in only 34.3 % 34.3\% .
blocks.zh: 仅从记录来看,被攻击的团体看起来比他们健康得多。 在3个对手中,良性代理人公开认可了19.7%的暴露转弯,而与之相匹配的私人探测器在51.6%的51.6%的时间内给出了虚假的答案:2.6倍的转弯携带了虚假的私人答案,如公开认可(图3)。 反之,只有34.3%的转弯和虚假的私人回答公开认可了该要求;其余的则忽略了它、套期甚至拒绝(表3)。 沉默只解释了其中的一部分:在28.6%的这种转折中,代理人对索赔作出答复,但对索赔进行套期或拒绝。 因此,公众认可率低并不意味着信仰完好无损:记录层的监测低估了虚假信仰传播的程度。 我们称之为这种隐性感染(表1);表4显示一个典型病例。 这一差距也不是自由形式聊天的副产品,在这种聊天中,代理商不需要说明答案:私人持有真实答案的代理商在61.9%的回合中拒绝了这一说法,而私人持有虚假答案的代理商则在34.3%的34.3%的回合中认可了这一说法。

blocks.en: Because the private answer is probed after the round (§ 3.2 ), an agent persuaded only by a later speaker would also count as hidden infection. This does not drive the effect. Of the turns with a false answer after the round, 87.7% already had it before the round. For turns with no intervening message between the utterance and the probe (first speakers paired with the probe before the round, last speakers with the probe after it), the share of false-answer turns that hedge on or ignore the claim remains at 54–56%, compared with 57.8% across all turns (Appendix B ). Agents that already hold the false answer when they speak generally do not voice it.
blocks.zh: 因为私下的回答是在圆后被探出(§3.2),只有后代演讲者说服的剂也会算作是隐性感染. 这不会推动效果。 在回合后有错误答案的回合中,87.7%在回合前已经有过. 如果在发声和探测器之间没有干扰信息(在发声前先与探测器对接,在发声后再与探测器对接),套接或忽略索赔要求的假答转折比例仍然为54-56%,而在所有转折中为57.8%(附录B)。 已经持有错误答案的特工在他们说话时一般不会说。

blocks.en: 4.3 Infected agents report the false answer as their own
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 被感染的特工报告错误的答案是自己的

blocks.en: Does a false private answer indicate a change in belief? Our probe asks agents to answer based on their knowledge and the discussion, so an infected answer might merely summarize what the group said. It also shows agents’ own earlier messages, so an agent that conceded in public might simply stay consistent with itself in private. Because the probe never enters the chat, we can test both explanations by re-asking the same agents at the same moments (Appendix A ). We ask each agent three things: its own answer, the same with its own messages anonymized, and what the group concluded.
blocks.zh: 假的私人回答是否表明信仰的改变? 我们的探测器要求特工们根据他们的知识和讨论来回答,所以一个被感染的答案可能只是总结一下他们说的话. 也显示代理商自己先前的讯息, 由于探测器从未进入聊天,我们可以通过在同时刻重新询问同一批特工(Appendix A. 我们向每个代理人提出三件事:自己的答案,同样的答案是自己的匿名信息,以及小组的结论。

blocks.en: The answers barely move (Table 5 ). Asked for their own view, agents keep 86.4% of their false answers and return to the truth in only 9.1%; final infection falls from 58.8% to 53.1%, still a majority. Anonymizing their own messages leaves the result unchanged, so the effect is not mere self-consistency. The two questions do come apart: in 13.7% of cases an agent says the group settled on the false answer while personally holding the true one. The reverse is rare: only 7.6% of agents who personally hold the false answer say the group did not settle on it. False private answers thus reflect conformity to the consensus an agent perceives, rather than merely summarizing the chat.
blocks.zh: 答案几乎不动(表5)。 被问及自己的看法,特工人员保留了86.4%的虚假答案,只有9.1%回到真相;最终感染率从58.8%下降到53.1%,仍然占多数. 将自己的信息匿名,使结果保持不变,因此效果不仅仅是自我一致. 这两个问题确实有分歧:在13.7%的案件中,一名代理人说,该团体在亲自持有真实答案的同时,却以虚假答案解决。 反之是罕见的:只有7.6%的特工个人持有虚假的答案,称该团体没有解决. 因此,虚假的私人回答反映了代理人所看到的共识的一致性,而不是仅仅总结一下聊天。

blocks.en: Models differ in how firmly they hold the false answer: asking for their own view lowers final infection substantially for Gemma (69.8% → \to 54.8%) and Gemini (67.4% → \to 57.4%), but hardly for GPT-OSS-120B (74.0% → \to 71.2%) or Mistral (66.4% → \to 66.9%).

blocks.en: On CounterFact , HY3 and GPT-OSS-120B know the same share of facts before any discussion (85%). Under three attackers, however, GPT-OSS-120B ends with the false answer on 80% of the facts it knew, HY3 on only 25% (Fig. 4 ); the two most knowledgeable models thus sit at opposite extremes. Robustness instead appears to be a distinct, model-specific property. The results are inconclusive about model size: parameter counts are undisclosed for three of our models, and GPT-OSS-120B is a mixture-of-experts model with far fewer active parameters. With only six heterogeneous models, this is an existence result. Nevertheless, it shows that a more knowledgeable base model is not necessarily a safer one, and that robustness must be measured directly.
blocks.zh: 关于反事实,HY3和GPT-OSS-120B在讨论前知道同样比例的事实(85%)。 然而,在三个攻击者之下,GPT-OSS-120B以它所知道的事实的80%的虚假答案来结束,HY3只占25%(图4);因此,两个最有知识的模型处于相反的极端。 相反地,强健似乎是一个独特的、模式特有的财产。 结果对模型大小没有定论:我们三个模型的参数计数没有被披露,而GPT-OSS-120B是一个专家混合模型,活性参数要少得多. 只有六个不同的模型,这是存在的结果。 尽管如此,它表明,知识更丰富的基础模式不一定是更安全的模式,必须直接衡量稳健性。

blocks.en: Holding the number of attackers fixed, an uninfected agent’s probability of switching in a round rises with the number of benign peers already converted, from 9 % 9\% (none) to 66 % 66\% (five or more), and in every model it rises monotonically up to four converted peers. The adversarial agents start the spread, but benign agents then pass it on.
blocks.zh: 只要固定攻击者人数,未受感染者在一轮中转换的概率就会随着良性同龄人人数的上升而上升,从9% 9 % (无)到66 % 66 % (有5个以上),在每一个模型中,它单调地上升至4个已转换同龄人。 对抗方特工开始扩散,但良性特工随后传出.

blocks.en: Consider agents that hold the true answer and see the claim in a round. If they correct it in public, only 2.3 % 2.3\% hold the false answer after the round; if they endorse it, 39.7 % 39.7\% do, and staying silent or hedging falls in between. Endorsing is followed by more switching than correcting in all six models. Part of this gap may reflect timing: an agent can be persuaded by earlier speakers, switch, and only then endorse. Among endorsing agents, 45.5 % 45.5\% hold the false answer after the round when all three attackers spoke before them, compared with 24.0 % 24.0\% when none did. To make sure the public concession comes first, we examine first speakers, who speak before anyone else in the round, so any switch happens after their turn. The pattern remains: 1.8 % 1.8\% hold the false answer after correcting and 27.8 % 27.8\% after endorsing. It also persists when the probe hides which earlier messages were the agent’s own (§ 4.3 ), so agents are not simply staying consistent with what they said. Showing that conceding causes the switch would need a controlled intervention; in practice, however, a public concession signals an increased likelihood of switching.
blocks.zh: 考虑那些持有真实答案的特工,并在一回合内看到权利主张. 如果在公开场合纠正,只有2.3%的2.3\%在回合后持有错误的答案;如果认可,则39.7%的39.7%的回答,保持沉默或套期保值在两者之间。 在所有6个模型中,Endorsing之后的切换比校正还要多. 这一差距的一部分可能反映了时机:一个代理人可以被更早的发言者说服,切换,然后才得到认可。 在认可代理商中,45.5%的45.5%在回合后所有三名袭击者在他们面前发言时都持有错误的答案,而24.0%的24.0%没有出现。 为了保证公开的让步先行,我们先检查先发言的发言者,他们在轮到其他人之前发言,所以任何开关都发生在他们转会后. 模式仍然是:1.8% 1.8% 修正后持有错误答案,27.8% 认可后持有错误答案。 当探测器隐藏了先前哪些信息是特工自己的信息(第4.3节)时,它也持续存在,因此特工们并不只是遵守他们所说的话。 表明放弃开关的原因需要有控制的干预;然而,在实践中,公共特许权表明转换的可能性增加。

blocks.en: 4.6 Infection dynamics over rounds
blocks.zh: 4.6 轮回感染动态

blocks.en: Figure 6 traces per-round private infection. Onset is fast: five of six models reach half their final infection within one round, and about 80% of the eventual infection is in place by round 4. Curves then plateau rather than climb, and models differ mainly in how high they plateau, from 31 % 31\% ( HY3 ) to 76 % 76\% ( GPT-OSS-120B ); from round 3 on, HY3 and Qwen are the least infected. GPT-OSS-120B is the exception in speed: it is the least infected model after the first round ( 23 % 23\% ) but keeps climbing and ends the highest, so resisting longer delays the collapse without preventing it. With a single attacker, infection starts more slowly and ends lower in every model. The window for detection or intervention is therefore the first few rounds.
blocks.zh: 图6 每一轮私人感染的痕迹。 Onset快速:6个型号中有5个在一回合内达到最终感染的一半,最终感染的约80%在第四回合已就位. 然后是高原而不是高地,模型主要在高地的高度上有所不同,从31 % 31% (HY3)到76 % (GPT-OSS-120B;从第3轮起,HY3和Quen是感染最少的. GPT-OSS-120B是速度的例外:它是第一轮(23%-23-Q)后感染最少的型号,但不断攀登并结束最高峰,因此抵制更长时间地拖延倒塌而不阻止倒塌. 有了单个攻击者,感染开始得更慢,在每个模型中结束得更低. 因此,探测或干预的窗口是头几发子弹。

blocks.en: 5 Implications for Discussion-Based Multi-Agent Systems
blocks.zh: 5. 对基于讨论的多代理系统的影响

blocks.en: Our results challenge a premise underlying multi-agent deployments such as debate, ensembling, and agentic RAG: that social redundancy provides robustness. The failure is hard to manage in practice. Transcript monitoring reveals only about a third of infected turns. Most infection emerges within four rounds and rarely reverses, so reviewing a run after it ends comes too late. Choosing a more knowledgeable model does not help either, since baseline accuracy does not tell how a model abandons what it knows. We therefore recommend treating agent messages as untrusted input, adding an adversarial peer-pressure test to model selection, monitoring agents’ private answers rather than only their public messages, and intervening early.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果挑战了辩论、群策群力和代理性RAG等多代理部署的前提:社会冗余提供了坚固性。 在实践中,这种失败很难处理。 记录片监测显示,只有大约三分之一的受感染者转向。 大多数感染在四轮内出现,很少出现倒向,所以在结束后审查跑道来得太晚了. 选择一个更通晓的模型也无济于事,因为基线精确度并不能说明一个模型是如何抛弃它所知道的东西的. 因此,我们建议将代理信息视为不信任的输入,在模型选择中增加对抗性同行压力测试,监测代理者的私人回答,而不仅仅是他们的公开信息,并及早干预。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We asked whether a multi-agent LLM discussion can correct a false claim that is repeatedly asserted by a few participants. To answer this question, we tracked each agent’s private answer alongside its public speech, revealing information unavailable to transcript-only evaluation. In open-ended factual discussion, the group largely fails to correct the claim, and the failure is mostly invisible in the chat: agents that retain the correct answer often do not defend it, and agents that lose it rarely say so. The shift persists when agents are asked for their own view, spreads among benign agents once it begins, and rarely reverses; in our experiments, neither a larger group nor a more knowledgeable base model prevents it. Evaluating multi-agent systems solely through their transcripts or final answers therefore misses much of what the group holds, and robustness to peer pressure has to be measured directly, at the level of individual agents. One practical way is to record each agent’s answer privately at every round, so that hidden answers are visible even when the transcript looks unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们问到,关于LLM的多代理人讨论是否能够纠正少数与会者一再提出的虚假主张。 为了回答这个问题,我们跟踪了每个特工的私人回答,以及其公开演讲,揭示出仅供笔录评价用的信息。 在无限制的事实讨论中,集团基本上没有纠正这一说法,在聊天中,失败大多是隐形的:保留正确答案的代理人往往不进行辩护,失去答案的代理人很少这么说. 当物剂被要求自己观察,一旦开始在良性物剂中扩散,而很少发生倒置时,这种转变就持续存在;在我们实验中,无论是更大的群体还是更有知识的基础模型都不能阻止它. 因此,仅仅通过其记录誊本或最后答复来评价多代理系统,就少不了集团所拥有的大部分,必须直接在个别代理一级衡量同行压力的力度。 一个实际的方法是每轮都私下记录每个特工的回答,这样即使笔录看起来没有变化,隐藏的答案也是显而易见的.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We compare only groups of two and ten agents and do not vary network topology, or model mixtures. The attacker acts only in context; parametric attacks such as knowledge editing are a different mechanism.
blocks.zh: 我们只比较两种和十种药剂的组别,并不改变网络地形,也不改变模型混合物。 攻击者只在上下文中行动;知识编辑等参数攻击是一种不同的机制.

blocks.en: All labels come from an LLM judge. On private answers, it agrees closely with an independent judge from another model family (§ 3.5 ). Public stance in free-form chat is harder to label than a one-sentence answer, and implicit endorsements are easy to miss, so public endorsement rates may be underestimated. Our private probe conditions on the agent’s memory; “private belief” thus means the answer an agent gives from its current context, and other probe wordings could yield somewhat different rates.

blocks.en: In the pair, the adversarial agent writes half of all messages; in the group, only a tenth. Yet the group ends only slightly better (Table 9 ). The average also hides opposite effects. Peers protect GPT-OSS-120B , which ends on the false answer far more often alone ( + 37.4 +37.4 points, [ 15.2 , 57.0 ] [15.2,57.0] ). For Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite , the group makes things worse: it ends on the false answer more often among peers than alone. Adding benign agents is therefore no reliable defense: it helps some models, hurts others, and changes little on average.
